interpretations: Average of per-line-item ratios (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost), computed for each invoice and grouped by invoice_number; top 10 invoices by line item count descending.
Ratio of sums: SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(derived_product_cost) per invoice, rather than the average of per-row ratios; top 10 by line item count descending.
Line items counted as rows in Invoice_Line_Items per invoice (COUNT(*)).
Line items counted as distinct order_item_id values per invoice.
Line items counted as distinct product_id values per invoice.
Line items counted as rows in Order_Items for the order tied to the invoice (via Invoices.order_id), instead of Invoice_Line_Items.
Invoices with zero line items are excluded, because they only appear through Invoice_Line_Items.
Invoices with zero line items are included (starting from the Invoices table with a left join), showing a null ratio and a count of 0.
Line items with a null or zero derived_product_cost are included, producing null or division-error ratios.
Line items with a null or zero derived_product_cost are excluded from the ratio average but still counted in the line item total.
Line items with a null or zero derived_product_cost are excluded from both the ratio average and the count.
Integer division is applied to the ratio, giving truncated values, instead of a decimal ratio.
Ratio computed as a decimal (cast to float) so fractional values are preserved.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, with exactly 10 rows returned.
Ties at the 10th position are all included, so more than 10 rows may be returned.
Ties are broken deterministically, for example by invoice_number ascending.
Ties are broken deterministically, for example by invoice_number descending.
Output columns are invoice number, average ratio, line item count, in that order.
Output columns may also include the line item count first or in a different order.
"Ratio of total cost to product cost" is read as derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost.
"Ratio of total cost to product cost" is read inversely as derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost.
"Total cost" read as derived_total_cost and "product cost" read as derived_product_cost, rather than product_price times product_quantity.
"Total cost" read as derived_total_cost and "product cost" read as derived_product_cost + derived_vat_payable.
"Most line items" ranking is by count of line items, descending, then limited to 10.
"Most line items" ranking is by quantity, with product_quantity summed across line items instead of the row count.
The average ratio is rounded to a fixed number of decimal places.
The average ratio is returned unrounded.

queries:
SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_ratio
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_product_cost) AS ratio
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number;
SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(DISTINCT order_item_id) FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number
SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number;
SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoices i
LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = i.order_id
GROUP BY i.invoice_number;
